article.title: The world since 7 October
article.author: Editor
article.content: Gaza is a generational touchstone and the key dividing line of politics in the West. It has laid bare the lies of the society we live in. It has exposed the genocidal bloodlust of the political right. And it has tested official “progressive” liberal politics. The post The world since 7 October appeared first on MR Online .
